name: Copper Socket
tagline: The charging backbone for every corner of your city.
positioning: Copper Socket turns owner-operators into charging landlords—deploy, meter, and monetize e-bike and scooter charging across your storefronts from one console.

hero.h1: Own the current beneath your city.
hero.sub: Copper Socket lets shop owners install, meter, and profit from micro-mobility charging bays—no utility contracts, no guesswork, no idle kilowatts.

features.title: Bays that bill themselves
features.description: Every charging bay meters to the watt and invoices riders automatically. You approve the rate; Copper Socket collects, reconciles, and deposits.

features.title: One console, every storefront
features.description: Run three locations or thirty from a single dashboard. See live occupancy, uptime, and revenue per bay without leaving the counter.

features.title: Uptime you can promise
features.description: Predictive fault alerts flag a failing connector before a rider ever does. Fewer refunds, fewer one-star reviews, fewer service trucks.

features.title: Rates that follow demand
features.description: Set surge windows for rush hour or discount slow afternoons. Copper Socket adjusts pricing per bay and shows the margin in real time.

features.title: Riders who come back
features.description: Branded QR checkout, saved payment, and a loyalty ledger tie every charge to your shop—not a faceless network app.

features.title: Install without an electrician on staff
features.description: Pre-configured bay kits ship ready to mount. Scan, name the location, and it joins your grid in under ten minutes.

testimonials.quote: I turned a dead corner of my bodega into six charging bays. Copper Socket handles the billing, so I just watch the deposits land. It paid for itself in eleven weeks.
testimonials.name: Marisol Tejada

testimonials.quote: We manage charging for four scooter fleets out of one back office now. The console tells me which bay is down before the driver calls me. That alone saved my weekends.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Okafor

testimonials.quote: The surge pricing tool is quietly brilliant. Evening rates fund my whole slow morning. Copper Socket made me a utility without making me learn to be one.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

pricing.blurb: For single-location owners lighting up their first bays.
For multi-location operators running a real grid.
For franchises and fleet partners scaling citywide.

homepage.footerBlurb: Copper Socket is the charging backbone for independent operators—metering, billing, and uptime for every micro-mobility bay you own.
